scope: Independent static source review of exact 1532:0245 basic built-in lighting. No production edits, hardware operations, updater execution or new frame admission.

criticalWindows.name: GET response clear and active bank
Saved-to-active record copy and renderer initialization

requiredImplementationBoundaries: Keep fresh exact runtime HID 1532:0245 and exact host admission; the source PID can be patched from persistent configuration.
Use active selector 0 and a 12-byte GET payload. Reject unknown modes, unsupported color counts, invalid direction/speed and inconsistent unused bytes.
Use the reviewed legacy 03/0A basic setters; do not substitute the same-effect-shortcut 0F/02 path.

After any legacy effect write, independently confirm the typed effect and reread active brightness before deciding whether a brightness setter is necessary. The setter activates a complete saved record, including brightness.
For Static, require count 1 and one RGB triple. For Breathing, admit only count 0 random or count 1/2 with corresponding RGB triples.
Wave accepts only reviewed wire directions 1 and 2, both consumed by the renderer, with fixed speed 40. Do not infer exact physical direction naming without the existing command contract.
Spectrum confirmation establishes its typed effect mode, not palette, pixel contents or exact phase restoration.
Do not admit custom frames or arbitrary RGB restoration from this basic-controls review.
limitations: The actual carrier extraction/applicability provenance is reused from the separate scout/source record; this review independently checks the derived HEX, image, identity path and command/consumer semantics.
Static source review is not attestation of installed MCU bytes or physical output.
